verdicts.observation: The 2x shoulder load reads as sticks, but the hair mask also selects several separated wood texels on the left; the white preview whitens the load beyond the two-texel allowance.
The carried sticks are legible, but the mask leaves dark hair patches and includes multiple texels at the right-hand load; the white preview does not isolate whole hair.
The 2x carry pose is clear, but blue coverage reaches the left sticks and several right load texels, producing white marks outside the hair beyond tolerance.
The sticks and south-facing carry pose read clearly. Several brown forehead/fringe hair texels remain inside the white-hair area, and the dark lower facial hair remains uncovered.
The east-facing load is legible, but a multi-texel brown fringe and lower long-hair patch remain outside the mask; the white preview retains substantial brown hair.
The sticks read at 2x, but the white preview retains a broad brown fringe inside the scalp region and the mask extends onto exposed face/arm areas.
The 2x load reads as sticks, but multiple separated left-side stick texels are included in the hair mask and become white in the preview, exceeding the non-hair allowance.
The east-facing carry is recognizable, but the mask covers several left bundle texels, including an isolated outer tip; the white preview whitens wood beyond the allowed two texels.
Rear-view sticks protrude on both sides at 2x. The hair mask also selects multiple left and right bundle/arm texels, producing white non-hair marks beyond tolerance.
Rear-view sticks protrude on both sides at 2x, but the mask includes the left shoulder/load texel and two adjacent right bundle texels, exceeding the two non-hair texel allowance.
The rear carry load is visible on both sides, but one left bundle texel and multiple right bundle texels are recoloured as hair; the white preview exceeds the non-hair tolerance.
The rear bundle reads on both sides, but several separate right stick/hand texels and a left shoulder texel are covered by the mask and turn white.
The crouched pickup reaches a visible stick at 2x, but the white preview leaves the broad dark beard/lower hair region uncovered, exceeding the hair-edge allowance.
The standing south-facing gather frame does not show a clearly identifiable held stick at 2x; the raised dark shape beside the torso reads as an arm/hand mass rather than gathered wood.
The bent east-facing pickup reaches a visible ground stick, but several brown fringe texels remain within the white-hair scalp region; the preview does not recolour the whole hair.
The raised stick is legible, but multiple texels of the stick/hand are selected by the mask and turn white, while brown fringe hair remains uncovered.
Carry load reads as sticks at 2x, but the blue hair mask covers multiple bundle pixels; the white preview recolours the wood.
Sticks remain legible at 2x, but multiple pixels of the left bundle are included in the hair mask and turn white.
Visible stick bundle passes action legibility; blue mask and white preview visibly recolour several wood pixels.
Carrying pose and sticks read at 2x, but the hair mask spills across the left bundle and right load edge beyond the two-pixel tolerance.
Profile carrying action is legible, but several horizontal wood pixels are blue-masked and white in the recolour preview.
Stick load is visible at 2x; the mask includes a broad horizontal section of the bundle, recolouring non-hair.
Walking carry and stick load are legible, but a horizontal band of bundle pixels is included in the hair mask.
Carry load reads as wood, but the blue mask covers multiple bundle pixels and the white preview changes their colour.
Rear carry shows protruding sticks; mask visibly includes several pixels of both load ends, making wood white.
Rear stick load is legible, but bundle pixels on both sides are included in the hair mask; dark interior rear hair also remains.
Rear carry has a visible stick bundle, but a multi-pixel band of the right bundle is blue-masked and turns white.
Rear carry and sticks are visible, but the mask includes wood on both sides and leaves a dark interior patch in rear hair.
Ground pickup and sticks are clear at 2x, but visible scalp and side hair have no meaningful mask coverage; white preview retains brown hair.
Held stick reads at 2x, but the mask covers only upper hair and leaves an extended dark-brown side-hair region in the white preview, beyond two edge texels.
Bent pickup pose clearly reaches for a ground stick, but visible scalp and long rear hair remain entirely brown in the white preview.
Held stick is visible at 2x, but the white preview retains brown interior side/scalp hair below the recoloured crown, beyond the edge tolerance.
Front carry shows a horizontal bundle with separate brown sticks and pale ends at 2x; child identity and cream clothing match.
Front stepping pose visibly supports a bundle across the shoulders; stick shafts and ends remain readable at 2x.
Front carry retains a compact but recognizable projecting stick bundle at 2x, with matching hair, tan skin and cream tunic.
Front carry has visible parallel wood pieces beside the head at 2x; pose and child proportions are coherent.
East-facing carry shows the bundle projecting behind the shoulder, with wood ends and short parallel shafts readable at 2x.
East-facing child supports a horizontal wood bundle with visible brown shafts and pale ends at 2x; identity remains consistent.
At 2x the shoulder load reads as rounded brown lobes beside the head; separate sticks or a bundled-stick silhouette are not legible.
At 2x the carried load merges into compact brown blocks around the head, without a readable stick bundle.
